scope.method: stdlib recomputation from saved records only
scope.validation_limit: Geometric length, task/arm ledger, stored feasibility and certificate identity checked; this script does not rerun collision/reachability geometry or IK.
scope.frozen_model_limit: Saved hashes and before/after snapshots checked; model tensors not loaded or replayed by this script.

formulas.delta_R: R_method - actual R_stop on same scene

saved_inference_replay.scope: Repeated model/input evaluations from 24 saved episodes; not additional plans, scenes, or reward queries

timing_contract.main: JSON scene read, fresh geometry/navigation, one certified Fixed3 anchor, menus, policy, repairs and final validation; model resident; evidence serialization excluded
timing_contract.ordering: Six-method rotation by selected case index; sequential timing, CPU one thread
timing_contract.note: Reported measurements only. A difference of method medians is not the median of paired differences.

limitations: 12 previously used development scenes; no independent held-out generalization claim.
Original Detour16 performs 192 repair calls; shared policies have different actions/work protocol and 19/13/15 proposals. No equal-work superiority claim.
Only one timing sample per case-method; no stable latency or real-time guarantee.
R uses a work proxy dominated by menus; R is not elapsed time.
72 saved artifacts and certificates do not constitute 72 independent scenes or 72 distinct routes.
Proxy-model feasibility is not real-arm IK, collision-free dual-arm motion, service duration, or physical safety certification.
CE and CE+gain checkpoints frozen; this evaluation provides no incremental PPO/DRL training benefit evidence.
